title: 555 exported symbols are referenced only inside their own file
body: A knip pass on 2026-09-05 (no config, default entry inference; cross-checked with rg for a 10-symbol sample) found 555 exports across 134 files that nothing outside the file imports; the top files are src/world/compact_view.ts (26), src/rpg/schema.ts (25), src/world/overworld.ts (22), src/blind/providers.ts (20) and src/world/campaign_character_state.ts (19). Most are Zod schemas still used inside their module, so this is export hygiene, not dead code: drop the export keyword so an rg for a symbol returns the real public surface. No unused npm dependency was found; bin/sync-intake-linear.ts and scripts/blind-report-recovery.ts were the only orphaned files and are removed with this audit.
